title: DomainDefinition
description: Operator definition of one domain (PRP-44): the authorization scope anchor every role, grant, connector and budget names. residency_region is the ARM region the domain's data is held in (Government domains use usgov*/usdod* regions; data is never bridged across clouds). The control domain is the reserved per-customer domain that holds platform configuration actions; at most one exists per customer (checked by the PRP-44 handler). A retired domain keeps its id for audit and accepts no new data.
